primary.null: Conditional on the complete finite-score cohort, its fixed score multiset, and the fixed spatial weights matrix, all assignments of score labels to eligible neighbourhoods are exchangeable. Each draw uniformly permutes those labels without replacement. Isolated units remain in that population with zero-weight rows. This is a spatial-randomness null, not a causal test.
primary.statistic_definition: (n / S0) * sum_ij(w_ij * z_i * z_j) / sum_i(z_i**2), with centred z
primary.expectation_definition: -1 / (n - 1), for zero-diagonal weights under total label permutation
primary.weights_definition: Queen: exact shared polygon boundary point or line; no buffers, snapping or added links
primary.standardisation: Non-isolated row weights sum to one; island rows sum to zero; diagonal zero

rook_sensitivity.null: Conditional on the complete finite-score cohort, its fixed score multiset, and the fixed spatial weights matrix, all assignments of score labels to eligible neighbourhoods are exchangeable. Each draw uniformly permutes those labels without replacement. Isolated units remain in that population with zero-weight rows. This is a spatial-randomness null, not a causal test.
rook_sensitivity.statistic_definition: (n / S0) * sum_ij(w_ij * z_i * z_j) / sum_i(z_i**2), with centred z
rook_sensitivity.expectation_definition: -1 / (n - 1), for zero-diagonal weights under total label permutation
rook_sensitivity.weights_definition: Rook: exact shared polygon boundary of strictly positive length; no buffers, snapping or added links
rook_sensitivity.standardisation: Non-isolated row weights sum to one; island rows sum to zero; diagonal zero

sensitivity_rule: Predeclared rook check on the identical cohort using the same seeded permutation stream; no selection of the smaller p-value
inference_scope: One primary global test; rook is a sensitivity analysis. No local p-values, local significance labels, or FDR claims

quadrants.z_definition: Population-standardised score within the complete spatial cohort (ddof=0)
quadrants.lag_definition: Weighted mean of neighbouring z scores; null for islands
quadrants.interpretation: Descriptive sign of z_score and spatial_lag_z relative to the cohort mean, not a local significance result
quadrants.axis_rule: Null quadrant if z_score or its spatial lag is within the stated tolerance of zero
